summary: Frontend-only iteration 6 targeting the profile REDESIGN + shared x-panel header/footer fix. Verified panel header and footer bars are EXACTLY 36px each and the footer sits flush with the card bottom (gap = 1px, pure sub-pixel rounding) for panel-identity, panel-password on /profile and panel-layout on /elements at 1920x1080, 1280x900, 768x1024 and 390x844, in BOTH light and dark theme. Footer spans full inner width (panel 1680 vs footer 1678 = 2*1px border). /profile now shows exactly two stacked panels ('Informasi diri' + 'Ubah kata sandi'), no old ringkasan/photo card, no 'Zona waktu' field anywhere. Identity save + reload persistence + topbar/sidebar name update all work. Avatar upload renders the /storage/avatars/*.png image (both profile-avatar and topbar-avatar visible in DOM after reload); Hapus foto (hidden DELETE form) removes it and profile-avatar-initials returns. Password flow: wrong current -> 'Kata sandi saat ini salah.', mismatch -> 'Konfirmasi kata sandi tidak sama.', valid change to Nexus2026Admin keeps session and reaches /dashboard, then REVERTED back to Admin12345 and final fresh login with Admin12345 confirmed. Password strength meter shifts from 'sedang' -> 'kuat' and eye toggle flips input type password<->text. Responsive at 390 and 768: scrollWidth == innerWidth, no window scroll, footer buttons stay inside the card. Regression: /dashboard /interface /elements /datatable all 200; Interface exposes 20 panels; Datatable shows total 43.875; theme toggle persists across reload; no Blade exceptions in laravel.log tied to the x-slot:footer change.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind CDN production warning still emitted (cdn.tailwindcss.com). Migrate to compiled Tailwind before shipping. Unchanged from iter 4-5.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
MEASURED PROOF for the panel header/footer fix (all values in CSS pixels, browser DPR=1):
  panel-identity light  1920: header=36 footer=36 gap=1  panelW=1680 footerW=1678
  panel-identity dark   1920: header=36 footer=36 gap=1
  panel-identity light  1280: header=36 footer=36 gap=1  panelW=1040 footerW=1038
  panel-identity light  768:  header=36 footer=36 gap=1  panelW=528  footerW=526
  panel-identity light  390:  header=36 footer=36 gap=1  panelW=366  footerW=364
  panel-password   at all four widths: header=36 footer=36 gap=1 (light + dark)
  panel-layout (/elements) at 1920/1280/768/390 in light+dark: header=36 footer=36 gap=1, footerWidth = panelWidth - 2 (1px border each side)
So the 'white strip below footer' bug is gone - the residual 1px is just the panel's border-b + rounded-lg subpixel. Threshold in the task (<=2px) is met everywhere.

Profile page structure: only two panels remain (panel-identity, panel-password) with titles 'Informasi diri' and 'Ubah kata sandi'. Fields present: Nama, Email, Telepon, Jabatan, Bio. No 'zona waktu' text or [name=timezone] input anywhere. Identity top row (avatar/initials + Unggah foto + hint + name + administrator badge) fits on one flex-wrap row at >=1280 and wraps gracefully at 390 without overlap/clipping.

Avatar: profile-avatar rendered with src=/storage/avatars/<hash>.png; the image loads visually and topbar-avatar becomes visible. (A raw urllib.request GET returned 403 without cookies/User-Agent - that is edge behavior, not the app: the img element loads fine in-browser.) After 'Hapus foto' the panel falls back to profile-avatar-initials (letter 'A').

Password: wrong current -> profile-errors contains 'Kata sandi saat ini salah.'; mismatch -> 'Konfirmasi kata sandi tidak sama.'; valid change -> profile-status 'Kata sandi berhasil diubah.' and session preserved (/dashboard 200 without redirect to login). Meter labels observed: 'kosong', 'sedang' (Weak1), 'kuat' (StrongPass2026!). apPwEye toggles input type between 'password' and 'text' for all three fields.

Regression: /dashboard, /interface, /elements, /datatable all 200. Interface exposes 20 non-header/footer panels. Datatable renders total 43.875. Theme toggle persists (dark class survives reload via localStorage). No Blade errors in laravel.log tied to the new x-slot:footer usage (one older 'View [datatable] not found' line exists in the log but is stale - live /datatable renders correctly with 200 and full content). Rate-limit: password endpoint is throttle:5,1 - test spaced the negative cases with fresh navigation between attempts; run 'cd /app/adminpanel && php artisan cache:clear' if 429 is hit.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a - both requested bug fixes are verified: (1) The redesigned x-panel is a flex-col with h-9 header + flex-1 body + optional h-9 footer flush against the border-b, so there is no leftover strip below the grey footer bar. (2) profile.blade.php now renders exactly two stacked form cards using x-slot:footer, and the timezone column was removed from ProfileController validation/assignment plus the view - confirmed by DOM scan (no 'zona waktu' text, no [name=timezone] input).
